ref_text: إي والله تأخرتوا، شنطتي زادت كيلو، ورسوم التخليص طلعت مية وعشرين ريال.

notes: Majed (a synthesiser voice described as measured and steady), a Najdi male support agent: one of the six voices the omnivoice_najdi model trained on (2,477 of his clips, 5.8 h, in Najdi and MSA). A customer complaining about a late delivery. Picked from his 14 held-out Najdi clips of 5-9 s: of the eight cloned on eight unseen sentences with the shipped model this one ranked first, and on 20 more held-out Najdi lines it beat the runner-up on UTMOS (+0.10 +/- 0.04) and on accent (P(Gulf) +0.24 +/- 0.07). His is the lowest UTMOS of the six trained voices (2.85; this clip itself scores 2.64), and his clones speak faster than he does (1.17x).
